title: Grateful Dead Live at Performing Arts Center on 1972-10-24
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi Dragon) -> Dat -> CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.2 -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> FLAC
source: Sony ECM-250 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-153/BASF Normal Bias 120 Min Tapes)

ai_review.summary: A soft, distant audience tape that still delivers a monster "The Other One" jam and an overall high‑energy show.
ai_review.review: Listeners note the recording is thin, with distant vocals and a cloudy mix typical of early ’72 field recordings, but once acclimated the performance shines. The second set – especially the Philo‑stomp on "The Other One" – is repeatedly praised, earning this concert a spot among many fans' favorites despite its sonic flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated very high (standout jam, strong energy) while recording quality is only fair (soft mix, distant vocals). Weighted combination yields a solid 3.9‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Distant, almost inaudible vocals; overall soft mix; thin bass and venue acoustics make the sound cloudy, though no major dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is less repeatable due to recording limitations, but the second set flows strongly with a highlight jam on "The Other One".
